name: Performance & Observability
objective: Improve fan-out throughput, load posture, auth soak coverage, and idempotency behavior so that the platform meets p95 SLO targets under mixed workflow traffic
gate: Gate D: p95 SLO and load profile validated under mixed workflow traffic. Criterion benchmark baselines established for all 11 Rust engines, orchestrator fan-out bounded by semaphore with backpressure, mixed-workflow k6 load profile passes p95<2000ms at 200 VU, auth soak survives 60-minute run with key rotation, idempotency keys prevent duplicate workflow submissions, and validation fixture packs cover all 16 engines with versioned expected outputs.

waves.name: Optimization & Hardening
waves.description: Tune orchestrator fan-out concurrency with semaphore-based backpressure, implement idempotency keys for workflow submissions, run auth soak tests with key rotation, and optimize cache layer performance

swarms.name: Fan-out Concurrency Tuning
swarms.description: Replace unbounded join_all fan-out in WorkflowOrchestrator and WorkflowExecutor with semaphore-bounded concurrency, add per-engine timeout enforcement, and validate under load

tasks.title: Add configurable concurrency limit to WorkflowOrchestrator
tasks.deliverable: WorkflowOrchestrator gains a max_concurrent_engines: usize field (default: 8) and uses tokio::sync::Semaphore to bound how many engines execute simultaneously in execute_workflow()
tasks.acceptance: With max_concurrent_engines=4 and 16 engines in full-spectrum, at most 4 engine futures are running concurrently at any instant
tasks.validation: Tracing logs show batched execution (groups of 4) rather than all 16 at once; unit test with timing-sensitive mock engines confirms bounded concurrency

tasks.title: Add configurable concurrency limit to WorkflowExecutor
tasks.deliverable: WorkflowExecutor::execute_engines_parallel() uses the same semaphore pattern to bound concurrent engine execution, configurable via WorkflowExecutor::new() parameter
tasks.acceptance: Full-spectrum workflow execution with concurrency limit 6 completes with all engines while respecting the bound
tasks.validation: Unit test asserts that with mock engines adding 50ms delay, full-spectrum with limit=4 takes approximately (16/4)*50ms = 200ms rather than 50ms

tasks.title: Add per-engine timeout enforcement in orchestrator fan-out
tasks.deliverable: Each engine future in the fan-out is wrapped in tokio::time::timeout (configurable per engine type: Rust engines 2s, TS bridge engines 5s) so slow engines don't block the entire workflow
tasks.acceptance: A mock engine that sleeps for 10s is timed out at 2s and its result is omitted from the workflow output without blocking other engines
tasks.validation: Unit test with one slow mock engine and one fast mock engine: fast engine result is present, slow engine is absent, total workflow time < 3s

tasks.title: Expose fan-out configuration via environment variables
tasks.deliverable: ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_ENGINES (default 8) and ORCHESTRATOR_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 2000 for Rust, 5000 for TS) read by ApiConfig::from_env() and wired into WorkflowOrchestrator construction
tasks.acceptance: Setting ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_ENGINES=4 at runtime limits concurrent engine execution to 4
tasks.validation: Integration test starts server with env var override and confirms behavior change via full-spectrum workflow response

tasks.title: Add backpressure metrics for orchestrator queue depth
tasks.deliverable: noesis_orchestrator_queue_depth Gauge and noesis_orchestrator_semaphore_wait_seconds Histogram added to NoesisMetrics, recorded when engines queue behind the semaphore
tasks.acceptance: Under load with max_concurrent_engines=4 and full-spectrum workflow, queue_depth shows values > 0 and semaphore_wait shows non-zero durations
tasks.validation: /metrics shows non-zero orchestrator queue metrics during concurrent full-spectrum requests

tasks.title: Add graceful degradation when all semaphore permits exhausted
tasks.deliverable: WorkflowOrchestrator returns HTTP 503 with Retry-After header when incoming workflow requests exceed a configurable pending-queue depth (default: 32), preventing unbounded memory growth under extreme load
tasks.acceptance: With max_concurrent_engines=4 and queue_depth_limit=8, sending 20 concurrent full-spectrum requests results in some receiving 503 with Retry-After header
tasks.validation: Load test at extreme concurrency (100 VU, full-spectrum only) shows 503 responses rather than OOM or hung connections

tasks.title: Benchmark fan-out throughput at concurrency limits 4, 8, 12, 16
tasks.deliverable: reports/benchmarks/fan-out-concurrency-sweep.json containing p50/p95/p99 workflow latency and throughput (req/s) at each concurrency limit with 50 concurrent users
tasks.acceptance: Report shows clear tradeoff curve between concurrency limit and latency/throughput
tasks.validation: Report identifies optimal concurrency limit that minimizes p95 while maximizing throughput

tasks.acceptance: Unit tests verify: store and retrieve entry, TTL expiry, concurrent access safety

tasks.title: Implement Redis-backed IdempotencyStore
tasks.deliverable: noesis-cache/src/idempotency.rs RedisIdempotencyStore that stores idempotency entries in Redis with SETEX for TTL enforcement, falling back to in-memory store when Redis is unavailable

tasks.deliverable: noesis-api/src/middleware/idempotency.rs with Axum Layer that: extracts Idempotency-Key header, checks store for existing response, returns cached response on hit (with Idempotency-Replayed: true header), stores new response on miss, returns 409 Conflict if key exists but request is still in-flight
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate POST to /api/v1/workflows/{id}/execute with same Idempotency-Key returns identical cached response with 200 status
tasks.validation: Integration test sends same request twice: first returns fresh response, second returns cached response with Idempotency-Replayed header

tasks.title: Wire idempotency middleware to workflow execution endpoints
tasks.deliverable: Idempotency middleware applied to POST /api/v1/workflows/{id}/execute and POST /api/v1/engines/{id}/calculate routes in the Axum router
tasks.acceptance: Workflow and engine execution endpoints enforce idempotency when Idempotency-Key header is present; requests without the header still execute normally
tasks.validation: Integration test confirms idempotency enforcement on workflow endpoint and passthrough on requests without the header

tasks.title: Add idempotency metrics (hit rate, store size, replay count)
tasks.deliverable: noesis_idempotency_hits_total Counter, noesis_idempotency_misses_total Counter, noesis_idempotency_replays_total Counter, noesis_idempotency_store_size Gauge added to NoesisMetrics

tasks.validation: Integration test: submit request, wait past TTL, resubmit with same key, verify new execution occurs

tasks.acceptance: Engine TTL values documented and configured: >300s for human-design/gene-keys (expensive), <60s for biorhythm/numerology (cheap)
tasks.validation: Config file shows per-engine TTL values; integration test confirms different TTL applied per engine

swarms.name: Documentation & Gate D Sign-off
swarms.description: Align all documentation to orchestrator-first usage patterns, update API docs with idempotency and concurrency parameters, and prepare Gate D sign-off checklist

tasks.title: Update API documentation for orchestrator-first workflow execution
tasks.deliverable: docs/api/ updated to present workflows as the primary API surface: workflow execution is the recommended entry point, single-engine execution is for advanced use cases; all examples use workflow endpoints first
tasks.acceptance: API docs lead with workflow examples before engine-level examples
tasks.validation: Documentation review confirms orchestrator-first narrative throughout

tasks.title: Document idempotency key usage in API reference
tasks.deliverable: API reference documents Idempotency-Key header: format (UUID v4), behavior (response replay), TTL (24h), and code examples in curl, Python, and JavaScript
tasks.acceptance: Idempotency section includes complete request/response examples showing key header and replay behavior
tasks.validation: Code examples in docs are tested and produce expected behavior

tasks.title: Document fan-out concurrency configuration and tuning guide
tasks.deliverable: docs/operations/concurrency-tuning.md documenting ORCHESTRATOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_ENGINES and ORCHESTRATOR_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS env vars, recommended values for different deployment sizes, and how to interpret backpressure metrics
tasks.acceptance: Guide includes concrete recommendations for small (4 concurrent), medium (8), and large (16) deployments
tasks.validation: Documented env vars match actual implementation and default values

tasks.title: Update llms.txt and README with P4 capability summary
tasks.deliverable: llms.txt and README.md updated to reflect: concurrency-bounded orchestrator, idempotency key support, p95 SLO targets, and benchmark baseline availability
tasks.acceptance: README performance section accurately describes current capabilities and SLO targets
tasks.validation: README review confirms accuracy against actual implementation

tasks.title: Create SLO definition document with error budget policy
tasks.deliverable: docs/operations/slo-definitions.md defining formal SLO targets per workflow type (e.g. daily-practice p95 < 500ms, full-spectrum p95 < 2000ms), error budget calculation (99.5% availability = 43.8min/month), and escalation procedure when budget is consumed
tasks.acceptance: SLO document covers all 6 workflow types with specific latency and availability targets
tasks.validation: SLO thresholds match the Prometheus alert rules from P4-W1-S3-04

tasks.title: Compile Gate D checklist with evidence artifacts
tasks.deliverable: docs/gates/gate-d-checklist.md linking to all evidence artifacts: benchmark baseline report, fan-out sweep report, mixed-workflow 200VU report, auth soak report, idempotency test results, fixture manifest
tasks.acceptance: Checklist has pass/fail status for each gate criterion with links to supporting evidence
tasks.validation: All checklist items link to existing artifacts and all items show pass status

tasks.title: Gate D sign-off: validate p95 SLO under mixed workflow traffic
tasks.deliverable: Formal Gate D sign-off document confirming: p95 < 2000ms for all workflows at 200 VU, benchmark baselines established for all 11 Rust engines, idempotency keys functional, auth soak with key rotation passes, fixture packs versioned and complete
tasks.acceptance: All Gate D criteria met with quantitative evidence; sign-off document approved by tech lead
tasks.validation: Gate D document signed off with date and approver; all linked reports validate the claimed results
